fact: 1928年5月，四家大片厂（Paramount 已退出该联盟后剩余者）连同联艺等公司分别与 ERPI（西电附属）签约，改造制片设施与影院以制作有声片。单座影院改造费用最高达1.5万美元（约合2019年的22万美元），当时全美有2万座以上影院，到1930年只有半数完成改造。

sources.title: Wikipedia，Sound film
sources.quote: Not until May 1928 did the group of four big studios (PDC had dropped out of the alliance), along with United Artists and others, sign with ERPI for conversion of production facilities and theaters for sound film. ... revamping a single theater cost as much as $15,000 (the equivalent of $220,000 in 2019), and there were more than 20,000 movie theaters in the United States. By 1930, only half of the theaters had been wired for sound.

sources.title: IMDb, The Jazz Singer Trivia（转向历时数年、两套系统不兼容）
sources.quote: The transition actually took several years. One factor was two competing, incompatible sound systems. The Vitaphone process relied on an electro-mechanical interface between the projector and the turntable. Fox's Fotofilm was a sound-on-film process that allowed for easier editing, but required a costlier projector. Using either sound process nearly doubled a film's budget. Theater chains faced enormous conversion costs. MGM's parent company, Loew's Inc., owned over 1,000 outlets, and took a deliberately slow wait-and-see attitude toward sound.

fact: 1928年7月6日，华纳兄弟出品的第一部全对白长片《纽约之光》（Lights of New York）首映，成本仅2.3万美元，票房125.2万美元，回报率超过5000%。同年9月，另一部乔尔森主演的部分对白片《歌唱的傻瓜》（The Singing Fool）上映，其插曲《Sonny Boy》在九个月内售出200万张唱片与125万份乐谱。系列转折的起点是1927年10月首映的《爵士歌手》，但它本身只是部分对白片，全行业转向实际历时数年。

sources.title: Wikipedia，Sound film
sources.quote: On July 6, 1928, the first all-talking feature, Lights of New York, premiered. The film cost Warner Bros. only $23,000 to produce, but grossed $1,252,000, a record rate of return surpassing 5,000%. In September, the studio released another Al Jolson part-talking picture, The Singing Fool ... inside of nine months, the Jolson number "Sonny Boy" had racked up 2 million record and 1.25 million sheet music sales.

sources.title: New World Encyclopedia, Sound film（《爵士歌手》与行业转向）
sources.quote: Though the success of The Jazz Singer was due largely to Jolson ... the movie's handsome profits were proof enough to the industry that the technology was worth the investment. ... No studio beside Warner Bros. released even a part-talking feature until the low-budget-oriented Film Booking Offices of America (FBO) premiered The Perfect Crime on June 17, 1928

fact: 1928年10月，FBO（Film Booking Offices of America）与 RCA 的联盟合并，成立好莱坞最新的大片厂 RKO Pictures。此前 FBO 已于1928年6月17日推出《完美犯罪》（The Perfect Crime），是华纳之外第一家发行部分对白片的公司；FBO 当时已被通用电气旗下的 RCA 部门实际控制，目的是推销其胶片录音系统 Photophone。

sources.title: Wikipedia，Sound film
sources.quote: No studio besides Warner Bros. released even a part-talking feature until the low-budget-oriented Film Booking Offices of America (FBO) premiered The Perfect Crime on June 17, 1928, eight months after The Jazz Singer. FBO had come under the effective control of a Western Electric competitor, General Electric's RCA division, which was looking to market its new sound-on-film system, Photophone. ... By October, the FBO-RCA alliance would lead to the creation of Hollywood's newest major studio, RKO Pictures.

fact: 1928年8月30日，联邦无线电委员会发布第40号一般命令（General Order 40），把广播频段划为96个间隔10千赫的频率（550至1500千赫），其中6个留给加拿大，90个给美国电台，并分为40个「清晰频道」（每区8个、单台功率上限通常5万瓦）、区域频道与本地频道三级。1928年11月11日凌晨3时（东部时间），全美大多数电台在同一时刻被迫换频。

sources.title: LegalClarity, Federal Radio Commission: Origins, Structure, and Legacy
sources.quote: The FRC's most dramatic act was General Order 40, issued on August 30, 1928, which completely reorganized the broadcast spectrum. At 3:00 a.m. Eastern time on November 11, 1928, most American radio stations were forced to change their broadcast frequencies in a single coordinated shift. The order defined the broadcast band as 96 frequencies spaced every 10 kilohertz, running from 550 to 1,500 kHz. Six of those frequencies were reserved for Canadian use, leaving 90 for American stations. ... Clear channels: Forty frequencies (eight per zone) reserved for a single dominant station nationally, with maximum power typically set at 50,000 watts.

fact: 1928年3月28日，美国国会通过《1927年无线电法》的续期法案（将该委员会授权延至1929年3月16日），并附加「戴维斯修正案」（Davis Amendment）：规定全美五个区的居民有权享有「平等的无线电广播服务」，委员会须尽可能在五区之间平均分配执照、频段、播出时段与电台功率，并在每区内按人口在各州之间公平分配。该修正案使 FRC 建立复杂的配额制度，1934年《通信法》将其移交联邦通信委员会，1936年6月5日被废除。

sources.title: Wikiwand, Davis Amendment
sources.quote: The Davis Amendment was a provision attached to the March 28, 1928 reauthorization of the Radio Act of 1927, which mandated an "equality of radio broadcasting service" within the United States. It specified an "equitable allocation" among five regional zones, in addition to assignments proportional to population among the states within each zone. ... it ultimately proved impractical, and was repealed on June 5, 1936.

sources.title: Federal Radio Commission, Fourth Annual Report to the Congress（STATE QUOTAS）
sources.quote: The amendment to the radio act of 1927, approved March 28, 1928, and generally referred to as the Davis amendment, requires that the Radio Commission "* * * shall as nearly as possible make and maintain an equal allocation of broadcasting licenses, of bands of frequency or wave lengths, and of station power to each of said five zones * * * and shall make a fair and equitable allocation of licenses, wave lengths, time of operation, and station power to each of the States * * * within each zone according to population."

fact: 1928年美国有声电影存在三套互不兼容的制式：华纳/西电的 Vitaphone（唱片与放映机机械同步）、福克斯的 Movietone（胶片录音，变密度）、RCA 的 Photophone（胶片录音，变面积）。Photophone 的变面积方式最终成为行业标准。使用任一制式几乎使一部影片的预算翻倍；影院改造与设备、合格技师的双重短缺，使米高梅的母公司 Loew's（拥有1000家以上影院）选择观望。

sources.title: Wikipedia，Sound film
sources.quote: Unlike Fox-Case's Movietone and De Forest's Phonofilm, which were variable-density systems, Photophone was a variable-area system—a refinement in the way the audio signal is inscribed on film that would ultimately become the standard.

sources.title: IMDb, The Jazz Singer Trivia

MGM's parent company, Loew's Inc., owned over 1,000 outlets, and took a deliberately slow wait-and-see attitude toward sound. Studio bosses faced a limited amount of sound equipment and qualified sound technicians.

fact: 美国家用电冰箱保有量从1923年1月的27,000台增至1928年1月的755,000台；零售额从1922年的400万美元增至1927年的8,212.5万美元，是同期家电中增速最快的品类。但1928年通电家庭（1,759.6万户）中拥有电冰箱者不足5%，远低于电熨斗（1,530万台）、吸尘器（682.8万台）与洗衣机（500万台）。

fact: 1928年1月16日，泛美航空公司（Pan American Airways）开通基韦斯特（佛罗里达）至哈瓦那的定期客运航班，这是其第一条定期国际客运航线；该航线的定期航空邮件服务始于1927年10月。同年2月20日，第六届美洲国家国际会议在哈瓦那通过《哈瓦那商业航空公约》。

sources.quote: January 16 – Pan American Airways (the future Pan American World Airways) begins scheduled passenger service between Key West, Florida, and Havana, Cuba, its first scheduled international passenger service. It had begun regular air mail service on the route in October 1927. ... February 20 – The Havana Convention on Commercial Aviation is adopted by the delegates to the Sixth International Conference of American States at Havana, Cuba.

fact: 1928年美国家庭的耐用消费品保有结构为：约2,700万户家庭拥有1,500万个电熨斗、680万台吸尘器、500万台洗衣机、450万台烤面包机、75万台电冰箱；登记汽车数从1920年的930万辆增至1929年的2,300万辆。这些数字说明1928年的「美国标准生活」仍以电熨斗与洗衣机为标志，电冰箱尚属少数。

sources.title: 界面新闻，谁能骑到新世界的背上（引1928年统计）
sources.quote: 1928年,2700万的美国家庭拥有1500万个电熨斗、680万台吸尘器、500万台洗衣机、450万台烤面包机和75万台冰箱。登记在册的汽车数量也从1920年的930万辆增加到1929年的2300万辆。
